experiments.description: New hypothesis: duplicated nested cleanup paths and result initialization before cleanup calls. Also corrected low-byte call-result tests and ~4 bit mask from retail instructions.
Declared speed before vertical, aligning speed=f31 and vertical=f30.
Explicit register parameter/result hints: no improvement; hints removed.

scratch.c_flags: -nodefaults -proc gekko -align powerpc -enum int -fp hardware -Cpp_exceptions off -O4,p -inline auto -pragma "cats off" -pragma "warn_notinlined off" -maxerrors 1 -nosyspath -RTTI off -fp_contract on -str reuse -multibyte -DVERSION_GEDE01 -DNDEBUG=1 -lang=c

compiler_policy: Unchanged GC/1.3 canonical command is recorded verbatim in verification evidence; no use_lmw_stmw override or pragma added.
relocation_verification: Explicit strict CLI run plus independent ELF32 RELA extraction and raw readelf tables. Signed addends are extracted directly, not inferred from counts. Extra helper relocations and shifted offsets prohibit a match.
dol_scope: Whole-DOL verification uses retail object for this NonMatching unit; it proves the canonical build remains retail-identical, not that the candidate matches.
divergence: Canonical and explicit name_address relocation-strict objdiff both measure 97.18644%; retail is 1180 bytes, candidate 1188. At retail +0x1c stmw r21,0x34(r1), candidate emits addi r11,r1,0x60 then bl _savegpr_21. Retail lmw r21,0x34(r1) at +0x488 is replaced by a helper sequence at candidate +0x488/+0x490, with lfd f30 interleaved. Retail parameters use r26-r30 and result r31; candidate parameters use r24-r28 and result r30. Retail state/target_state/distance/valid/visible use r22/r23/r24/r25/r21; candidate uses r29/r31/r21/r22/r23. This shifts ordinary instruction offsets by four bytes and rotates 101 aligned instruction arguments. Both duplicated cleanup blocks, low-byte result tests, bit-2 masks, vector stack slots, and f30/f31 roles now agree structurally. Candidate has 60 relocation sites versus retail 58 due to _savegpr_21 and _restgpr_21; the other 58 ordered relocation types, symbol names, symbol values and signed addends are equal, but offsets differ. Exact relocation records are unequal. Canonical compiler settings remain unchanged; unit remains NonMatching.
scope: Only target C source and assignment-specific reports changed. Registration remains NonMatching. Pre-existing CLAUDE.md modification excluded.
